annotation.title_clean: Commission Recommendation of 5 April 2013 on a common framework for a unique device identification system of medical devices in the Union (2013/172/EU)
annotation.title_en: Commission Recommendation of 5 April 2013 on a common framework for a unique device identification system of medical devices in the Union (2013/172/EU)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 99/17
annotation.summary_en: 2013 European Commission Recommendation urging Member States to adopt compatible, risk-based unique device identification (UDI) systems for medical devices, aligned with the GHTF/IMDRF approach. It sets UDI structure, obligations for economic operators and health institutions, and national database data elements. It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: UDI comprises a device identifier and production identifier, in both human-readable and AIDC formats
Risk-based, gradual implementation starting with the highest risk class devices
Manufacturers, importers, distributors and health institutions should keep electronic UDI records
Member States should build national UDI databases using XML, to feed a future European UDI system in Eudamed
Aligned with international GHTF/IMDRF UDI guidance to avoid divergent systems
